       br.birth_weight_kg, br.delivery_type, br.remarks
FROM person p
JOIN birth_record br ON p.person_id = br.child_id
JOIN pregnancy pr ON br.pregnancy_id = pr.pregnancy_id
JOIN family f ON pr.mother_id = f.family_id
WHERE f.area_id = 1

query_name: what is the sex ratio in my area ?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'M' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / 
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS sex_ratio
FROM person p
JOIN family f ON p.family_id = f.family_id
WHERE f.area_id = 1 AND p.status = 'ALIVE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS population_count
FROM person p
JOIN family f ON p.family_id = f.family_id
WHERE f.area_id = 1
  AND p.status = 'ALIVE';
